text:
Carlos (sales): ACME follow-up: they want a 10-working-day pilot for our chat endpoint. Legal demands EU residency + proof of KMS integration. Can we scope and pick a mode today?
Priya (presales): Recommend we map two tracks: (A) Hosted EU region for fastest rollout, (B) Dedicated reserved pool in EU if they need key isolation or prolonged throughput.
Mei (customer-eng): They also want sample SLOs for the pilot: sustained 40 req/s during peak, p95 latency <=300ms, and a held-back eval set where we must hit >=85% quality.
Sven (security): From the questionnaire they attached: must show KMS key usage logs, support SAML for admin access, and ensure logs can be forwarded to customer SIEM with 90-day retention. Hosted EU supports KMS but HSM-backed keys are only on Private or Dedicated HSM addon.
Carlos (sales): Procurement asked specifically: "If we do Hosted, can we bring our KMS key?"
Priya (presales): Short answer: yes for Hosted EU we can support customer-managed keys via our KMS integration, but if they require HSM-backed keys only, that's a Dedicated/Private conversation and will add setup time (~2-3 weeks).
Lina (product): For success criteria, propose: 1) functional correctness: >=85% on 200 eval prompts (mix short + 2-3k token passes), 2) perf: p95 <=300ms, 3) cost delta: demo cost estimate within 15% of their procurement target, 4) security checks: KMS + SIEM hookup validated.
Mei (customer-eng): They want us to pre-run the evals on a pinned model version and share raw outputs. Can we pin a model in Hosted?
Priya (presales): Yes. In Hosted we can pin model x.y.z for the trial and enable prefix cache. If they later sign, move to Dedicated with same model pin to reduce variance.
Carlos (sales): Timebox: Kickoff Monday -> run evals Tue-Thu -> final demo next Monday. Any blockers with that timeline?
Sven (security): If they insist on HSM day-0, timeline slips. Also need to confirm inbound IP ranges for their firewall (they want static egress IPs).
Mei (customer-eng): I'll ask which KMS vendor they're using and whether they need HSM. Uploading SQ: https://acme.example/pilot-sq
infra-bot: NOTE: Dedicated cluster provisioning lead time ~ 5 business days after approval; run `infra api cluster status` to check capacity.
Priya (presales): Pricing: rough Hosted EU estimate for 10 days at 100k tokens/day -> ballpark $A. Dedicated short-term: minimum 1-month commitment $Bk + lower per-token. I'll post numbers to procurement channel.
Carlos (sales): Can we provide a one-page tech appendix describing fallbacks (model routing, region failover, cache warm)? Customers care about fail-open behavior.
Lina (product): I'll draft appendix: include routing policy example, cache warm steps, and a canary-to-dedicated plan.
Sven (security): Action items for me: annotate SQ with allowed responses, mark any items that require Dedicated/Private, and validate SIEM export method (syslog vs API).
Mei (customer-eng): Action: confirm KMS vendor and whether they require HSM-backed keys. Will also get firewall IPs.
Priya (presales): I'll prepare two deployment templates (hosted-eu and dedicated-eu) and an eval runbook with the 200 prompts.
Carlos (sales): Great. Everyone, please drop updates here. If procurement pushes for cost breakouts, ping me.
Priya (presales): Example hosted snippet we'll share:
```
mode: hosted
region: eu-central-1
model_pin: rwd-model-2.0
kms: customer-managed
prewarm: true
```
Lina (product): Also adding quality checks: automatic hallucination count, entity extraction F1, and a manual spot-check sample of 20 outputs.
infra-bot: Reminder: To ensure static egress for Hosted, request NAT allocation with account ops; this may add 1 business day.
Carlos (sales): Thanks team. If no blockers by EOD I'll tell ACME we recommend Hosted EU for pilot and show Dedicated as the production ramp path. :rocket:
Sven (security): A quick note: if they require SIEM via private peering only, we'll need Dedicated/Private. Flagging that as potential deal blocker.
Priya (presales): I'll upload the cost comparison and runbook to the shared folder and tag procurement.
Mei (customer-eng): I'll loop in the customer's infra lead and ask about KMS + firewall.
Carlos (sales): Closing loop 7:30pm UTC: deadlines set.
